demo.program:
# El Salvador — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is the capital of El Salvador?", "San Salvador"),
    ("What currency does El Salvador use?", "US Dollar"),
    ("What is capital?", "San Salvador"),
    ("What is currency?", "US Dollar (USD)"),
    ("What is calling code?", "+503"),
    ("What is internet domain?", ".sv"),
    ("What is driving side?", "right"),
    ("What is continent?", "North America"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
